profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Epsilon C5I

positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Developed new features in C++ for the Cooperative Engagement Capability (CEC), a real-time sensor netting system, and provided support to existing geospatial features.
•Worked in a team operating in an Agile environment attending daily Scrums in two-week long sprints.
•Employed specialized techniques to test software for the Data Distribution System in charge of the real time communication for the CEC Program.

positions.title: Payload Computer Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborate with a team to design an autonomous rover for the NASA Student Launch 18-19 competition
• Evaluate components to determine effectiveness and viability
• Design and implement rover automation and interaction with various sensors and motors.

company.name: Society of Asian Scientists and Engineers (SASE)

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description:
• Maintained and recorded accurate notes during officer meetings whilst providing own input
• Increased membership by over 200% through the online club portal
• Acted as a liaison the between executive board and general members by updating them on upcoming organization activities and opportunities

positions.title: Programming Committee Southeast Regional Conference
positions.description:
• Assisted in organizing the 2018 Southeast Regional Conference with a $10,000 budget and an attendance of over 200 STEM students
• Organized several professional development workshops for attendees to provide a valuable experience
• Troubleshooted any technically difficulties that arose during the workshops and conference

positions.title: Food Service Worker
positions.description:
•Operated the register and engaged with over 100 customers daily.
•Prepared and serve drinks while following proper safety and health protocols.
•Cataloged and restocked inventory as necessary

positions.title: Mailroom Assistant
positions.description:
•Constructed over 300 information packets daily for incoming USF students.
•Organized and mailed over 100 admission letters daily to newly accepted students.
•Handled inventory management and maintenance of the storeroom.
